blockers: No authorized LeadSquared test account is available.
The authenticated MCP tool list and tool schemas have not been observed.
OAuth tenant compatibility, granted permissions, and revocation have not been tested.

service.transport: HTTP; the vendor documents this URL with Claude's HTTP MCP connection option.
service.region_note: The vendor help article publishes this exact endpoint. Its hostname contains pulseai-in21; compatibility with a particular customer's tenant or region has not been probed. Do not substitute a regional LeadSquared REST API host.

authentication.interaction: Complete the LeadSquared browser login and grant the permissions requested by the connector.
credential_handling_source_claims: LeadSquared says credentials are used to establish a session and are not stored by the client or connector.
LeadSquared says the connector receives a short-lived session token, encrypted at rest, and that the client does not see that token.
authentication.oauth_metadata_status: Unprobed. Do not invent issuer, authorization, token, registration, redirect, or scope values.
authentication.static_api_keys: Not part of this MCP draft. LeadSquared REST API access-key and secret-key authentication is a separate interface; do not place those keys in this spec.

access_policy.enforcement_boundary: The agent allowlist must contain only individually verified, retrieval-only MCP tools. OAuth login alone does not establish a read-only boundary; use an account with the least permissions available and keep all non-read or ambiguous tools out of the agent.
exclude_if_tool_can: update, merge, invalidate, or delete records
create, update, complete, reschedule, or delete tasks or activities
change permissions, preferences, configuration, or other state
perform any action whose effects cannot be established from its exact schema and vendor documentation
access_policy.classification_rule: Do not infer MCP tool identifiers from labels in LeadSquared's help article or from REST API operation names. Record identifiers and schemas only from the authenticated server tools/list response.

required_order.name: authorized_tenant_and_user
required_order.requirement: Obtain an authorized non-production LeadSquared tenant, a user with the least available permissions, and synthetic records approved for read testing. Record tenant region and user role without recording credentials or customer data.

required_order.name: oauth_pkce_connection
required_order.requirement: Connect to the exact endpoint over HTTP with an MCP-compatible client. Follow only the OAuth challenge and metadata advertised by the server; complete the browser PKCE login and consent flow. Record the observed issuer, requested/granted scopes, redirect behavior, client registration behavior, and revocation path. Redact tokens and secrets. Stop if the consent or permission boundary is unclear.

required_order.name: initialize_and_tools_list
required_order.requirement: After authentication, capture the MCP initialize response, then request tools/list and follow every nextCursor until pagination ends. Save the raw, redacted response with timestamp, endpoint, client, and tenant region. Do not call any tool during inventory.

required_order.name: per_tool_read_only_review
required_order.requirement: For every candidate tool, preserve the exact server-provided name, title, description, input schema, output schema if present, and annotations. Map its behavior to first-party documentation or an observed implementation contract. Add only tools proven to retrieve data without changing CRM state. Treat missing, broad, conflicting, or ambiguous evidence as a rejection.

required_order.name: approved_read_smoke_call
required_order.requirement: Call only a tool that passed step 4, using a known synthetic record. Save the redacted request and response and confirm the target record and related state are unchanged. Never probe a suspected write tool, even with dummy input.

required_order.name: revoke_and_record
required_order.requirement: Disconnect through the documented client integration settings, confirm subsequent access is rejected or requires re-authentication, and record the result.

pass_criteria: The exact published endpoint completes OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for the intended tenant and user.
The complete authenticated tools/list response and schemas are captured; every paginated result is reviewed.
Each allowlisted tool is individually proven retrieval-only; no unknown or mutating tool is allowlisted.
An approved synthetic read succeeds and leaves CRM state unchanged.
Disconnect/revocation behavior is observed and documented.
The draft JSON is updated with exact observed tool identifiers and evidence, while remaining outside the publishable catalog until separately reviewed.
fail_criteria: No test account, failed or ambiguous OAuth, tenant/region incompatibility, or unclear consent.
Incomplete tool listing, missing schemas, undocumented behavior, or any candidate whose effects are ambiguous.
Any need to call a potentially mutating tool to discover its behavior.
A read smoke call changes CRM state or cannot be safely isolated to synthetic data.

sources.title: Connect LeadSquared CRM to Claude
sources.supports: Published MCP endpoint, HTTP client setup, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, connector security claims, user-role behavior, and the fact that the connector includes both read and write actions.

sources.title: LeadSquared API Host
sources.supports: REST API hosts vary by account region; this does not establish regional behavior for the published MCP endpoint.

sources.title: LeadSquared API Authentication
sources.supports: LeadSquared REST API access-key and secret-key authentication, documented separately from the MCP OAuth flow.
